title: Farland Story: Habou no Mai
native_title: ファーランド・ストーリー ～破亡の舞～
overview:
Rich strategy unlike any other

Farland Story: Habou no Mai is a simulation RPG in the Farland series, an enhanced version of Farland Story 2. Lead your party across battlefield maps, attacking with weapons and casting healing and offensive spells. Wide-area magic can wipe out whole groups of enemies at once, and hiring mercenaries lets you build new strategies. When units clash, the fight plays out as a comical battle animation with 3D CG rendered characters.

- Full strategy RPG with easy-to-learn controls
- Hire mercenaries to expand your army
- Memory backup
- Shuttle Mouse compatible
